text: Titan's hull was a tube of carbon fibre. And that was the risk.
Carbon fibre is light, and incredibly strong when you pull on it.
But deep underwater, a hull isn't pulled. It's squeezed. And for thick carbon fibre, squeezed again and again, there's far less proof.
Dive after dive, its layers can start to separate, and the damage hides inside.
And at each end, it was glued to titanium, a metal that squeezes by a different amount.
On its last dive, the hull gave way. Full video on my channel.
